pages.title: Welcome
pages.content:
# Welcome to the Family Wiki

This is your family's own record book. A few things you can do:

- Create a page for a recipe, a story, a relative, or a house you lived in
- Organize pages into categories using the sidebar
- Link to another page by writing its title in double brackets, like [[Grandma's Kitchen]]
- Upload photos to pages using the **📷 Upload Image** button, drag & drop, or pasting (`Ctrl+V` / `Cmd+V`)
- Toggle light or dark mode anytime with the 🌙/☀️ button in the top bar
- Search everything from the top bar

Start by clicking **+ New Page**.
